BACKGROUND: storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py and RuntimeEngine record an AttemptBundle per turn with transition_cause in none|earned|forced|timer, observed from the branch that changed the scene (see engine.py, search transition_cause / timer_transition). tests/test_attempt_bundle.py covers 'forced' (test_real_staged_handoff_is_recorded_as_forced) but NOT the two other causes. The design-review gate requires proof that a LATE EARNED exit (player's own earned action after turns_since_scene_entry >= handoff_after_turns) is labelled 'earned', not 'timer'/'forced' (the old blind-player mislabelled this as timer), and that a deadline/clock-driven exit is 'timer'.

ADD two or more tests, hermetic, real engine with stub providers, real package data, no network, no xfail:
 1. test_late_earned_exit_is_recorded_as_earned: a scene change committed after handoff_after_turns has passed, caused by the player's earned reveal (provider selects the reveal / earned route), with staged_handoff_fact_ids empty or the provider selecting the reveal so the forced path does not run. Find a real earnable exit: read tests/test_narration_corpus.py, tests/test_design_review_fixtures.py, tests/test_runtime_engine*.py and any test that moves between scenes by a player action (grep engine.turn with state.current_scene_id assertions) and reuse that setup, then set state.turn_index / scene_entered_at_turn so turns_since_entry exceeds handoff_after_turns. Assert transition_cause == 'earned', committed_delta.scene_from/scene_to, and that a FORCED exit in the same state differs.
 2. test_deadline_backstop_exit_is_recorded_as_timer: a scene change by the resolution deadline backstop or timed route event without an earned reveal (see _apply_resolution_deadline_backstop and _apply_canonical_route_events; reuse existing tests that exercise them). Assert 'timer'.
If a case truly cannot be built from real package data, build the closest real case and say exactly why in notes.md; if the engine labels a case wrongly, fix the minimal logic in engine.py and add a regression assertion.
